title: nutty, bouncy ukrainian pork grill
description: quick-fix ukrainian dish featuring pork tenderloin and a nutty fermented twist.

ingredients.name: pork tenderloin
ingredients.notes: 1 pork tenderloin, trimmed of excess fat

instructions: heat olive oil in a comal or large skillet over medium-high heat.
add a pinch of salt and pepper to the oil, and swirl to combine.
add the pork tenderloin to the comal, and sear until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
remove the pork from the comal, and set aside to rest.
add the minced fermented garlic to the comal, and cook for 1 minute.
add the chopped walnuts to the comal, and cook for an additional minute.
add the dried thyme to the comal, and cook for 30 seconds.
return the pork to the comal, and coat with the nutty garlic and walnut mixture.
transfer the pork to a plate, and garnish with chopped parsley.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
